result: Stepped, source-bound GeoTIFF previews and a bounded verified-original cache; no runtime action.

acceptance.originals: Read-only practice files served through fake S3 bodies; byte counts and manifest hashes verified.
acceptance.raster: Full-extent bounds, nearest output and masks, actual-span affine and numpy valid extrema match.
acceptance.stepped: 128 x 128 at step 32 inside both files took under 10 seconds; second read made no S3 request.
acceptance.regression: NYC step-one TIFF hashes and native LAS/LAZ records remain unchanged; clipped/all-masked cases pass.
acceptance.cache: Hash/size failures leave no copy; hits consume no body; LRU eviction enforces size and free-space floor.
acceptance.contracts: Steps 0/1.5/4097 refused; both overview receipts accepted; 16 MiB plus one direct byte refused.
review: Last source column/row accepted at steps 1 and 4; one extra output column/row refused, not upsampled.
1000 x 1000 legacy null-window crop accepted without step; changed origin/width or explicit step refused.
Cross-disk hardlink failure gives plain words; a wrong-size cache entry is removed and reverified.
Studio's over-limit ortho row now names the 2 GiB reader; no application UI code changed.

decisions: Optional step stays absent in legacy contract pins; receipt comparison normalizes absence to one.
Legacy null-window receipts without step accept only the old exact first crop; new receipts use whole extent.
Cache leases serialize readers and eviction across processes; LAS/LAZ use temporary hardlinks, not second copies.
Unmasked non-finite samples keep their valid count but omit an unrepresentable finite range; empty ranges are null.
logs: E:/ulpin-tmp/s5-11/{before,after,review}-*.log; Python uses specified d07 interpreter and s5-11-site.
